gui.guhs.kledingbron.bestaand: The Skewer Keep and the Mika Grill Palace
block.guhs.bestaand_zielig_lantaarntje.l: It always looks a little sad. Pet it (right-click) and it cheers right up. Nyeg!
block.guhs.bestaand_knuffelguh.lore: Sewn with love by the Plushie Maker Guh. Go on, give it a squeeze (right-click)!
block.guhs.bestaand_knuffelmika.lore: Looks grumpy, feels soft. Guaranteed not to swipe any nibbles.
block.guhs.bestaand_knuffelrookguh.lore: A sad little puff of smoke to fall asleep against. No feeding needed.
item.guhs.bestaand_aansteekspies.lore: Borrowed. Right-click a cold bridge brazier with it: fwoosh!
item.guhs.bestaand_recept_lantaarn.lore: Lets you make Sad Little Lanterns. The recipe simply stays in your crafting table.
item.guhs.bestaand_recept_knuffel.lore: The Plushie Maker Guh's pattern: wool, string and a little bit of love. Stays in your crafting table.
gui.guhs.bestaand.vuur.aan: FWOOSH! The bridge fire on the %s bridge is burning again (%s/%s).
gui.guhs.bestaand.vuur.al_aan: This bridge fire is already burning. Nice and toasty, nyeg!
gui.guhs.bestaand.vuur.spies: No little flame, no fire: right-click the brazier with the Guard Guh's lighting skewer.
gui.guhs.bestaand.vuur.uit: A cold brazier. The Guard Guh in the hall of the Skewer Keep surely knows more about it.
gui.guhs.bestaand.vuur.alle: All four bridge fires are burning! Go tell the Guard Guh.
gui.guhs.bestaand.kruid.weg: Rrrip! Mika Weed out (%s/%s). It gave one last grumpy hiss.
gui.guhs.bestaand.kruid.alle: The little garden is tidy again! The peanut sprouts breathe a sigh of relief. Go back to the Guard Guh.
gui.guhs.bestaand.kooi.onbekend: Stolen plushies... The captured Plushie Maker Guh on this floor surely knows more about it.
gui.guhs.bestaand.kooi.slot: The cage is locked. Slip a wahoog chonk through the bars, or sneak (crouch) and fiddle the lock open while no Mika is looking.
gui.guhs.bestaand.kooi.betaald: The Mikas snatch your chonk and very obviously look the other way. The plushie wriggles out between the bars! (%s/%s)
gui.guhs.bestaand.kooi.open: Click! The lock pops open and the plushie wriggles out between the bars! (%s/%s)
gui.guhs.bestaand.kooi.betrapt: HEY! PAWS OFF, NYEG! A Nether Mika spotted you and gives you a shove.
gui.guhs.bestaand.kooi.al_vrij: This cage is empty: your plushie is already back with the Plushie Maker Guh.
gui.guhs.bestaand.kooi.alle: All three plushies are free! Go to the Plushie Maker Guh.
gui.guhs.bestaand.lantaarntje.blij: The little lantern cheers right up from your pet. Nyeg!
gui.guhs.bestaand.lantaarntje.zielig: The little lantern looks a bit sad again. Just the way it should.
gui.guhs.bestaand.beloning.knuffels: Three plushies: guh, Mika and Smoke Guh
gui.guhs.bestaand.commando.stand: Guard: step %s (fires %s, weed %s). Plushie Maker: step %s (cages %s).
gui.guhs.bestaand.commando.gewist: The questlines of the Guard Guh and the Plushie Maker Guh have been cleared for %s.
quest.guhs.bestaand.wachter.hallo: HALT! Who goes there?! ... Oh, a visitor. Sorry, nyeg: force of habit. I'm the Guard Guh and I've been guarding this statue since back when this place was only lukewarm. But just look at that: the four bridge fires are out! Without fire, no guh can see where the bridge ends and the frying sauce begins.
quest.guhs.bestaand.wachter.wat: The Spark Mikas! They blow them out, just for fun. 'Then WE burn the brightest,' they say. Show-offs. And I can't leave my post: who else would look after the statue? Well? Exactly.
quest.guhs.bestaand.wachter.start: Wahoog! Here, my lighting skewer. On every bridge there's a brazier on a pedestal: four bridges, four fires. Right-click them with the skewer. And don't fall in the sauce, nyeg!
quest.guhs.bestaand.wachter.hint.vuren: light the four bridge fires: there is a brazier on every bridge of the Skewer Keep (right-click with the lighting skewer)
quest.guhs.bestaand.wachter.vuren_nog: Still %s of the %s bridge fires to go. I can see it from here: it's as dark as a burnt nibble over there.
quest.guhs.bestaand.wachter.spies_kwijt: Lost my lighting skewer? Nyeg... luckily I have a whole rack of them. Here.
quest.guhs.bestaand.wachter.brug_dicht: On one bridge the brazier has gone missing (bricked in? eaten?). I'll count that one as done, nyeg.
quest.guhs.bestaand.wachter.vuren_klaar: They're burning! All four! I can see the bridges again, and the bridges can see me. Wahoog! But now that I've got somebody who IS allowed to leave their post... the little peanut sauce garden upstairs is full of Mika Weed. The Mikas sow it, out of pure nyeg. Will you pull it out?
quest.guhs.bestaand.wachter.tuin_start: The little garden is one staircase up, in the middle of the keep. You'll know Mika Weed right away: purple, prickly and it gives you a grumpy look. I count %s clumps. Just pull them out: click on them!
quest.guhs.bestaand.wachter.hint.tuin: weed the clumps of Mika Weed in the little peanut sauce garden (one staircase up, in the middle of the Skewer Keep): click on them
quest.guhs.bestaand.wachter.tuin_nog: Still %s clumps of Mika Weed in the little garden. The peanut sprouts don't dare grow past them anymore.
quest.guhs.bestaand.wachter.klaar: Four fires lit, garden tidy: THAT's how a keep should be! From now on you're an honorary guard, nyeg. Here: my spare helmet (the one with the satay plume), a guard's cloak and the recipe for my little lantern. It always looks a little sad, but if you pet it, it cheers right up. Just like me.
quest.guhs.bestaand.wachter.bedankt0: The fires are still burning, you know. I check every five minutes. Well, I'm always checking. I'm a guard.
quest.guhs.bestaand.wachter.bedankt1: Do you know what I guard here? The statue. And do you know what the statue does? Nothing. Best colleague I ever had, nyeg.
quest.guhs.bestaand.wachter.bedankt2: If the Spark Mikas come blowing again, I'll blow right back. Wahoog hard.
quest.guhs.bestaand.wachter.recept_kwijt: Lost the recipe? A guard keeps two of everything. Here, nyeg!
quest.guhs.bestaand.knuffelmaker.hallo: Psst! Hey, you there! Not so loud... I'm the Plushie Maker Guh. The Mikas took me along, AND all my plushies. Now I have to darn Mika socks all day long. SOCKS! And my plushies are stuck in those cages, all alone. Will you help them out?
quest.guhs.bestaand.knuffelmaker.waarom: Walk away? The door is open, yes. But I'm not leaving without my plushies, nyeg! And honestly... Big Nether Mika is never here. He lives in his own castle, somewhere in the sauce sea. Here there's only a little sign minding his throne.
quest.guhs.bestaand.knuffelmaker.start: Three cages, three plushies. The ransom is one wahoog chonk per plushie: right-click the cage with a wahoog chonk (or a chonk ingot) in your hand. No chonk? Then sneak (crouch) up to a cage and fiddle the lock open while no Mika is looking. Caught? Then you get a shove. That's all, nyeg.
quest.guhs.bestaand.knuffelmaker.hint.ko: free the three plushies from the cages on this floor: pay one wahoog chonk per cage, or sneak (crouch) and fiddle the lock open while no Mika is looking
quest.guhs.bestaand.knuffelmaker.kooien_: Still %s of the %s plushies are locked up. I can hear them squeaking, nyeg. Well, plushies don't squeak. But I can HEAR it.
quest.guhs.bestaand.knuffelmaker.kooi_we: One cage is already broken (who does such a thing?). That plushie must have escaped: I'll count that one as done.
quest.guhs.bestaand.knuffelmaker.draad: All three of them are here! Come here, my fluffy little chonks... Oh no. The Mikas have been tugging at them: every little seam has come loose. Bring me %s string and I'll sew them back up. Nether Mikas sometimes trade it for a chonk ingot, the thieves.
quest.guhs.bestaand.knuffelmaker.hint.dr: bring string to the Plushie Maker Guh (Nether Mikas trade string for a wahoog chonk ingot)
quest.guhs.bestaand.knuffelmaker.draad_t: I see %s of the %s string. No thread, no plushie, nyeg.
quest.guhs.bestaand.knuffelmaker.klaar: Stitch, stitch, done! As good as new. You know what? You take three with you, I've got plenty more in my head. And here is my plushie pattern: with it you can sew them yourself, as many as you like. I'll stay a little longer. The Mikas need something to cuddle TOO. Them most of all.
quest.guhs.bestaand.knuffelmaker.bedankt: Ever since you came by, I've been secretly sewing little ears onto all the Mika socks. They haven't noticed a thing, nyeg.
A plushie is only finished when it looks a little lopsided. That's not a mistake, that's personality.
Big Nether Mika? Never seen him. His throne just sits here, doing nothing. They say he has a castle of his own, in the sauce sea.
quest.guhs.bestaand.knuffelmaker.patroon: Lost my pattern? I'll draw a new one in a jiffy. Here, nyeg!
quest.guhs.bestaand.knuffelmaker.optie.w: Why don't you just walk away?
gui.guhs.verhalen.wachter.naam: The Watch at the Skewer Keep
gui.guhs.verhalen.wachter.uitleg: The Guard Guh guards the statue in the Skewer Keep, but the bridge fires are out and his little garden is full of Mika Weed.
gui.guhs.verhalen.wachter.stap.3: Weed the little peanut sauce garden
gui.guhs.verhalen.wachter.nu.0: Talk to the Guard Guh. He stands in his sentry box next to the statue, in the hall of a Skewer Keep.
gui.guhs.verhalen.wachter.waar.0: A Skewer Keep in the Guhbarbecuether (Super Compass: Barbecue)
gui.guhs.verhalen.wachter.nu.1: On every bridge of the Skewer Keep there's a cold brazier on a pedestal. Right-click all four with the lighting skewer.
gui.guhs.verhalen.wachter.waar.1: The four bridges of the Skewer Keep
gui.guhs.verhalen.wachter.nu.2: The fires are burning! Go back to the Guard Guh in the hall.
gui.guhs.verhalen.wachter.waar.2: The hall of the Skewer Keep (Guhbarbecuether)
gui.guhs.verhalen.wachter.nu.3: Pull the clumps of Mika Weed out of the little peanut sauce garden: click on them. The garden is one staircase up, in the middle of the keep.
gui.guhs.verhalen.wachter.waar.3: The little peanut sauce garden of the Skewer Keep
gui.guhs.verhalen.wachter.nu.4: Everything is tidy again. Go back to the Guard Guh.
gui.guhs.verhalen.wachter.waar.4: The hall of the Skewer Keep (Guhbarbecuether)
gui.guhs.verhalen.wachter.nu.klaar: The fires are burning and the garden is tidy. You're an honorary guard, nyeg!
gui.guhs.verhalen.wachter.waar.klaar: The hall of the Skewer Keep (Guhbarbecuether)
gui.guhs.verhalen.knuffelmaker.uitleg: The Mikas of the grill palace took the Plushie Maker Guh along, AND all his plushies.
gui.guhs.verhalen.knuffelmaker.nu.0: Talk to the captured Plushie Maker Guh. He sits in his sewing corner, one floor up in a Mika Grill Palace.
gui.guhs.verhalen.knuffelmaker.waar.0: A Mika Grill Palace in the Guhbarbecuether (Super Compass: Barbecue)
gui.guhs.verhalen.knuffelmaker.nu.1: Open the three cages: pay one wahoog chonk per cage, or sneak (crouch) and fiddle the lock open while no Mika is looking.
gui.guhs.verhalen.knuffelmaker.waar.1: One floor up in the Mika Grill Palace (Guhbarbecuether)
gui.guhs.verhalen.knuffelmaker.nu.2: The plushies have been tugged apart. Bring string to the Plushie Maker Guh.
gui.guhs.verhalen.knuffelmaker.waar.2: The sewing corner in the Mika Grill Palace
gui.guhs.verhalen.knuffelmaker.nu.klaar: The plushies are free and whole again. Wahoog!
gui.guhs.verhalen.knuffelmaker.waar.klaa: One floor up in the Mika Grill Palace (Guhbarbecuether)
advancements.guhs.barbecuether.bestaand_: Relight all four bridge fires of a Skewer Keep
Help the Guard Guh of the Skewer Keep: four fires lit, garden tidy
Fiddle a plushie cage open without a Nether Mika seeing it
Free the stolen plushies for the Plushie Maker Guh in the Mika Grill Palace
structure.guhs.fossiel_opgraving.tooltip: A dig with the skeleton of a giant guh, and the Archaeologist Guh (Guhbarbecuether)
structure.guhs.zoutkristalmijn.tooltip: A mountain of salt with a mine inside: this is where the crystal vein is, and the Mineworker Guh (Guhbarbecuether)
item.guhs.zoutkristal.lore: Pink, grainy and nice and savory. You use it to make the clever machines of Guh Technology.
block.guhs.fossielmijn_fossielbeeldje.lo: Tyrannoguhrus Nyex, the king of the nibblers. Millions of years old and still peckish.
item.guhs.fossielmijn_bot_schedel.lore: Belongs on the rack at the Fossil Dig
item.guhs.fossielmijn_bot_ruggengraat.lo: Belongs on the rack at the Fossil Dig
item.guhs.fossielmijn_bot_ribben.lore: Belongs on the rack at the Fossil Dig
item.guhs.fossielmijn_bot_pootjes.lore: Belongs on the rack at the Fossil Dig
item.guhs.fossielmijn_bot_staart.lore: Belongs on the rack at the Fossil Dig
item.guhs.fossielmijn_kwastje.lore: Hold right-click on bone sand. Every day there's something new in the sand again, nyeg!
item.guhs.fossielmijn_zoutkristalhouweel: Chips twice as much salt out of the crystal vein
gui.guhs.fossielmijn.eerst_praten: First ask the Archaeologist Guh what you're allowed to do here, nyeg
gui.guhs.fossielmijn.alle_botten: That's all five of them! Put them on the rack under the little roof
gui.guhs.fossielmijn.gekwast: You've already dusted here. Look for another patch of bone sand, nyeg
gui.guhs.fossielmijn.dag_leeg: This patch is empty for today. Tomorrow there'll be something again, nyeg
gui.guhs.fossielmijn.rek.leeg: An empty rack. The Archaeologist Guh surely knows more about it
gui.guhs.fossielmijn.rek.geen: This is where the Tyrannoguhrus Nyex goes. You're not carrying a bone right now that still needs to go on
gui.guhs.fossielmijn.rek.af: It's standing! Tell the Archaeologist Guh. WAHOOG!
gui.guhs.fossielmijn.rek.klaar: Your Tyrannoguhrus Nyex. Just look at those little ears!
quest.guhs.fossielmijn.archeoloog.hallo1: Nyeg! Careful where you step! Here lies the find of the century: a real Tyrannoguhrus Nyex!
quest.guhs.fossielmijn.archeoloog.hallo2: The big one stays where it is, but there's a little one left in the bone sand. Here, a Guh Dusting Brush: dust five bones loose for me!
quest.guhs.fossielmijn.archeoloog.kwast_: Lost your brush? Nyeg nyeg. Here's a new one. Don't eat it!
quest.guhs.fossielmijn.archeoloog.zoek: You have %s of the 5 bones. Look for the bone sand in the pit: there's a little tip of bone sticking out of the ash.
quest.guhs.fossielmijn.archeoloog.bouw: Wahoog, all five! Now put them on the rack under the little roof. There are %s of the 5 on it.
quest.guhs.fossielmijn.archeoloog.bot_we: Did you lose a bone? Luckily I had a plaster cast of it. Here!
quest.guhs.fossielmijn.archeoloog.klaar1: WAHOOG! It's standing! Just look at that: those little ears, those little teeth... Tyrannoguhrus Nyex, the king of the nibblers!
quest.guhs.fossielmijn.archeoloog.klaar2: This statuette is for you. And go ahead and keep the brush: every day there's something new in the bone sand again.
quest.guhs.fossielmijn.archeoloog.tip0: With its stubby little legs the Tyrannoguhrus couldn't reach its own nibbles. That's why it went extinct. I think. Nyeg.
quest.guhs.fossielmijn.archeoloog.tip1: Every day the ash pushes up something new. Feel free to come dusting!
quest.guhs.fossielmijn.archeoloog.tip2: I'm still looking for a Guhceratops. See a bone with three little horns? Give me a shout!
quest.guhs.fossielmijn.archeoloog.tip3: No nibbling on the finds. That goes for me too. Especially for me.
gui.guhs.fossielmijn.puin_klaar: The track is clear! Follow it to the cave with the crystal vein
gui.guhs.fossielmijn.ader.eerst: The Mineworker Guh wants the track cleared first, nyeg
gui.guhs.fossielmijn.ader.houweel: You need a pickaxe for that
gui.guhs.fossielmijn.ader.gevonden: The crystal vein! Wahoog! Bring the Mineworker Guh three salt crystals
gui.guhs.fossielmijn.ader.hak: +%s salt crystal (%s left in the vein for you)
gui.guhs.fossielmijn.ader.op: The vein has run out for you for now. Salt grows back by itself: come back later, nyeg
gui.guhs.fossielmijn.beloning.ader: The crystal vein: your very own supply of salt, which always grows back
quest.guhs.fossielmijn.mijnwerker.hallo1: Nyeg, what a rubbly mess! The roof came down and now my whole cart track is covered in rubble.
quest.guhs.fossielmijn.mijnwerker.hallo2: My back has called it quits. Will you chip five chunks of rubble off the track? Then I'll tell you where the salt is!
quest.guhs.fossielmijn.mijnwerker.puin: Still %s chunks of rubble. They're on the track, in the tunnels of the mountain. Get chipping! Did somebody else just clear the track? Wait a minute, nyeg: the roof keeps crumbling.
quest.guhs.fossielmijn.mijnwerker.ader: Wahoog, the track is clear! Follow it all the way into the cave at the end: that's where the crystal vein is. Go on, give it a whack!
quest.guhs.fossielmijn.mijnwerker.breng: You found the vein! Bring me three salt crystals for my sandwich. You have %s right now.
quest.guhs.fossielmijn.mijnwerker.klaar1: Mmm, salt! Without salt a nibble tastes like nothing at all. WAHOOG!
quest.guhs.fossielmijn.mijnwerker.klaar2: This Salt Crystal Pickaxe is for you: it chips out twice as much. And the vein? It always grows back. Chip away!
quest.guhs.fossielmijn.mijnwerker.voorra: The vein has %s crystals ready for you right now. Salt grows back by itself, nyeg.
quest.guhs.fossielmijn.mijnwerker.tip0: No salt, no flavor. No flavor, no guh. It's that simple.
quest.guhs.fossielmijn.mijnwerker.tip1: With salt crystal you make clever things: tubes, sensors, a Nom Hatch... Just ask the Inventor Guh.
quest.guhs.fossielmijn.mijnwerker.tip2: Salt crystal ore also just sits in the rocks around here. But only where nobody has ever been before, nyeg.
gui.guhs.fossielmijn.commando.stand: Fossil mine of %s: bones found %s, on the rack %s, rubble %s, salt in the vein %s
gui.guhs.verhalen.archeoloog.uitleg: The Archaeologist Guh has made the find of the century. But the little skeleton is still lying in pieces in the bone sand.
gui.guhs.verhalen.archeoloog.stap.3: Show it to the Archaeologist Guh
gui.guhs.verhalen.archeoloog.nu.0: Find the Fossil Dig and talk to the Archaeologist Guh by his tent.
gui.guhs.verhalen.archeoloog.waar.0: The Fossil Dig in the Guhbarbecuether
gui.guhs.verhalen.archeoloog.nu.1: With the Guh Dusting Brush, hold right-click on the bone sand in the pit until you have five bones.
gui.guhs.verhalen.archeoloog.waar.1: The pit of the Fossil Dig
gui.guhs.verhalen.archeoloog.nu.2: Click the rack under the little roof with the bones.
gui.guhs.verhalen.archeoloog.waar.2: The rack at the Fossil Dig
gui.guhs.verhalen.archeoloog.nu.3: Tell the Archaeologist Guh that the Tyrannoguhrus is standing.
gui.guhs.verhalen.archeoloog.nu.klaar: The Tyrannoguhrus Nyex is standing! Every day there's something new in the bone sand to dust loose.
gui.guhs.verhalen.archeoloog.waar.klaar: The Fossil Dig in the Guhbarbecuether
gui.guhs.verhalen.archeoloog.kort.1: Dust five bones loose from the bone sand
gui.guhs.verhalen.archeoloog.kort.2: Put the bones on the rack
gui.guhs.verhalen.mijnwerker.uitleg: The cart track of the Salt Crystal Mine is covered in rubble, and the Mineworker Guh hasn't had salt on his sandwich for days.
gui.guhs.verhalen.mijnwerker.nu.0: Find the Salt Crystal Mine and talk to the Mineworker Guh by his little shed.
gui.guhs.verhalen.mijnwerker.waar.0: The Salt Crystal Mine in the Guhbarbecuether
gui.guhs.verhalen.mijnwerker.nu.1: Chip five chunks of rubble off the track in the tunnels of the mine.
gui.guhs.verhalen.mijnwerker.waar.1: The tunnels of the Salt Crystal Mine
gui.guhs.verhalen.mijnwerker.nu.2: Follow the track all the way into the cave and use a pickaxe on the pink crystal vein.
gui.guhs.verhalen.mijnwerker.waar.2: The cave at the end of the track
gui.guhs.verhalen.mijnwerker.nu.3: Bring three salt crystals to the Mineworker Guh.
gui.guhs.verhalen.mijnwerker.waar.3: The little shed by the mine
gui.guhs.verhalen.mijnwerker.nu.klaar: The crystal vein is yours: it always grows back. With salt crystal you make the clever machines of Guh Technology.
gui.guhs.verhalen.mijnwerker.waar.klaar: The Salt Crystal Mine in the Guhbarbecuether
gui.guhs.verhalen.mijnwerker.kort.1: Chip five chunks of rubble off the track
gui.guhs.verhalen.mijnwerker.kort.2: Mine the crystal vein in the cave
gui.guhs.verhalen.mijnwerker.kort.3: Bring three salt crystals to the Mineworker Guh
advancements.guhs.barbecuether.fossiel_m: Dust the bones loose and put the skeleton together at the Archaeologist Guh's
Clear the cart track and find the Mineworker Guh's crystal vein
Find salt crystal: in the crystal vein of the Salt Crystal Mine or in salt crystal ore
